titles.romaji: Tottoko Hamtaro Movie 1: Ham Ham Land Daibouken
titles.english: Hamtaro Movie 1: Ham Ham Land Big Adventure
titles.native: とっとこハム太郎 ハムハムランド大冒険

description: It's Laura's birthday, and Laura isn't paying much attention to him. Hamtaro then went with the ham-hams to ham ham land. Hamtaro is searching for the magic sunflower seed, but, he will have to battle Maou-hamu for it.
